about: I'm a Software Engineer with three years of enterprise consulting behind me: backend services, RESTful APIs and microservices, taken from analysis all the way to delivery.

I work at Cluster Reply in Rome, where I design .NET microservices and SQL Server schemas running on Docker and Kubernetes, and build Python APIs with FastAPI, LangChain and Azure OpenAI in which AI agents automate checks on financial documentation.

I use agentic coding tools like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot every day, and I've taken them beyond the editor: AI Factory is a system of agents that designs, builds and opens pull requests on GitHub Actions, behind branch protection and cost guardrails. This portfolio is wired into it.

I hold a Master's degree in Computer Science (Cloud Computing) from the University of Salerno, graduated 110/110 cum laude, with a thesis on agent-based modeling and deep reinforcement learning against fake news. I'm a Microsoft Certified DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400) and speak English at C1 level.
Outside of work I play guitar and bass, go to the gym and build custom PCs.

projects.title: All to All MPI Optimization
projects.description: Implemented and analyzed multiple All-to-All communication algorithms using OpenMPI, based on optimization strategies presented in scientific literature. The project focused on performance evaluation and parallel communication efficiency.

projects.title: GitProtocol P2P
projects.description: In this project, a basic implementation of the Git protocol was created using a P2P (peer-to-peer) network. Each peer in the network can manage its own projects (a set of files) using a simplified version of the Git protocol. The system allows users to create a new repository in a specific folder, add new files to be tracked, apply changes to the local repository (commit function), push changes to the network, and pull changes from the network. The Git protocol follows a specific behavior to handle conflicts, which are then resolved manually.

projects.title: MPI Parallel Game Of Life
projects.description: Project completed as part of the "Concurrent and Parallel Programming on the Cloud" course.It presents a solution to the Game of Life problem by leveraging parallelism through the OpenMPI library. The program was executed on an AWS cluster, and performance metrics were analyzed.The project received the highest possible grade in the course.

projects.title: Snap Meta
projects.description: I developed and published a Flutter-based mobile app for a popular strategy card game, achieving 5,000+ organic downloads on Google Play. The app keeps users updated on meta trends with a database of cards, game mechanics, news, and tier lists, helping them optimize decks. Built with Flutter/Dart and hosted on GitHub Pages, it cost nothing to run. I managed the full development cycle, from coding to user support.
